## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Treatment
where: TreatmentService (uses), src/business/treatmentService.ts, component business
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
return this.treatments.create({ hiveId, productId: found.id, startDate: start, endDate: end });
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B
concept: Treatment Product

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A Treatment is one application of a product to a particular hive over a period of time. In TreatmentService, `this.treatments.create({ hiveId, productId: found.id, startDate: start, endDate: end })` builds a treatment record that points to a product by its id. A Treatment Product is a catalogue entry for the product itself, stored by TreatmentProductRepository in `Map<string, TreatmentProductRecord>`. The graph also shows separate repositories: TreatmentRepository.create/findByHive and TreatmentProductRepository.create/findAll/findByName. So the two are linked by a reference (productId) but are not the same thing under different names.
